description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pitipana North, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520006 (7576)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land parcel records, including ownership details, title classifications, encumbrances, and servitude rights for various land parcels in the Colombo District. The content is purely land and property-related, focusing on title registration amendments without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land matters.
